hero.composition: Large decision headline paired with a restrained product visual.
hero.media_strategy: One product-context image rather than a decorative dashboard.

typography.body_style: Compact geometric sans for long-form reading.
typography.scale: Large first-viewport headline with restrained section headings.

sections.composition_notes: Decision context split between claim and explanation.
Benefits read as a vertical evidence ledger.
Proof appears as a bounded horizontal strip.
Workflow is expressed as a clear sequence.
Limitations are compared by impact and mitigation.
Objections remain scannable and progressively disclosed.
Questions alternate to avoid a generic repeated stack.
Final decision and CTA share one strong closing composition.

cta.placement: One primary CTA in the hero and one closing decision CTA.
cta.label_pattern: Short buyer-decision verb phrase without an embedded arrow.
cta.interaction: Solid accent, label and icon kept on one line.

motion.triggers: Hero hierarchy on load and sections on viewport entry.
motion.intensity: Restrained transform and opacity changes only.
motion.reduced_motion_behavior: All content remains visible with motion removed.

mobile.stacking: Headline and answer, decision CTA, then media.
mobile.cta_behavior: Inline only; no fixed or sticky duplicate CTA.
mobile.overflow_behavior: No horizontal page overflow; intentional strips use scroll snap.

reusable_principles: Use an editorial hierarchy to make the buyer decision obvious.
Separate proof, limitations, and action into visibly different rhythms.
prohibited_copy_notes: Do not copy brand names, logos, copy, imagery, exact palette, proprietary icons, or exact composition measurements.
